items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend shift for this deemed-delivery rule). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, i.e. on the day in December numerically matching the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in Hamburg (not a Sunday/holiday), so no further shift applies.

warnings: This is a rejection of an extended closing-time exception for the café, not a fine or payment demand; no money is owed under this letter.

Deemed-delivery (4 days after posting) was applied because the letter was sent by ordinary post; if the actual arrival date is known and later, the one-month Widerspruch period would run from a later day instead.
